plugins.name: diff-lens
plugins.description: Cursor-style git change review in a session side panel: cascading status tree with per-folder badges, inline Monaco diff (single- or dual-pane), per-file revert, and one-click hand-off to the agent.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 会话侧栏的 Cursor 风格 Git 变更审查：级联状态文件树、Monaco 行内 diff、单文件还原、一键交给 Agent 审查。
